author: MarioNawfal
text:
🚨🇸🇦 BREAKING:

Saudi Arabia has restarted its East-West Pipeline and is set to resume exports from Yanbu, per sources.

Drone attacks originating from Iraqi territory forced Saudi to shut it down 9 days ago; many said it would take weeks or even longer to resume operations.

But 3 sources briefed on the matter say it could resume exports from the Red Sea port of Yanbu later TODAY.

However, it is also noted the pipeline is pumping "at a low rate."

Regardless, this is GREAT news...

Source: Reuters / Writer: Michael
